digest.component_or_area: reconciler JIRA adapter / config ownership gate
propositions: 12 ambient config reads below the in-process AST gate in reconciler JIRA adapter files are flagged as LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS because composed-config reads (JIRA_URL/USER/PROJECT, timeout knobs, verbose flag) bypass owned resolvers in the composition root.
11 of 12 flagged reads must be cut-to-seam by delegating to owned config.py/config_sources.py resolvers (live-per-call) while preserving adapter helper signatures and live env-over-file precedence.
1 flagged read (REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE in outbound_fields.py) is marked with # read-via: to indicate owned-in-place treatment; no other listed read is marked.
The secret credential reads (JIRA_API_TOKEN, JIRA_PAT) are already owner=credential and owned; they remain unchanged and out of scope.

All 12 LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS rows must be removed and check_config_ownership.py must pass with zero findings on the 6 affected files, verified by held-out oracle test asserting marker-total==1 and per-file placement.

Behavior regressions for JIRA-endpoint live precedence, insecure-url fail-loud, DC fail-loud, acli-timeout clamp, and rich_text/wiki_render ImportError-to-default degrade must remain green across unit and integration test consumers.
